title: No reading is rejected; an implausible value asks to confirm, then saves
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  3. Note the unit's last recorded mileage and engine hours with their date, for example 342,417 and 6,388 on 29 Aug 2026 (38 days before 6 Oct 2026).
  4. Work out the ceilings by hand: mileage 1,500 a day × 38 days = 57,000, so anything above 342,417 + 57,000 = 399,417 is implausible; engine hours 24 a day × 38 days = 912, so anything above 6,388 + 912 = 7,300 is implausible.
custom_steps:
1. On the asset's Maintenance tab press Enter mileage, type 350,000 (below the ceiling) and press Save the reading. Then press Undo on the toast.
  2. Press Enter mileage, type 420,000 (above the ceiling) and press Save the reading.
  3. Read the message that appears and note its colour; then confirm it (the spec and the design give no wording for the confirm button).
  4. Read the Mileage card.
  5. Press Enter mileage, type 7,500 engine hours (above the ceiling) and press Save the reading; read the message and confirm it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 350,000 saves at once with no warning.
  • 420,000 is not rejected: an orange, plainly worded confirmation appears, never red and never blocking; after confirming, it saves and the Mileage card shows 420,000.
  • 7,500 engine hours behaves the same way.
  • What counts as implausible is more than 1,500 mileage a day, or more than 24 engine hours a day, since the last reading.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10567 (S10, Enter a reading); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S10; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-N1: “No reading value is ever rejected by validation”
  • S10-N2: “An implausible value shows an orange, plainly worded confirmation and saves on confirm. Never red, never blocking. The same figures as S11-R19 decide what is implausible: more than 1,500 mileage a day, or more than 24 engine hours a day, since the last reading”
